messages:
deploy-bot: preflight checks finished for release v2026.03.22-rc3 — all smoke tests passed, routing checks ok, canary started at 10% traffic. details: https://internal.redwood/ci/1745554322 :rocket:

maya: noticing p95 spike on SLO dashboard for /embeddings (eu-west) just after traffic shift, p95 jumped from 120ms -> 450ms, small 5xx bump (~0.6%). attaching chart: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/1745554322

kai: seen it. looks like KV cache miss rate spiked at the same time. could be model shard warmup or quantization path mismatch.

sophie: logs show repeated 502s with "rpc_timeout" coming from embed-worker-3. short tail: ```2026-03-22T17:02:12Z embed-worker-3 ERROR rpc_timeout call=kv_fetch shard=12```

ron: ops-bot auto-halt? ops-bot, did deploy-bot stop ramp?

ops-bot: Deploy control: Canary phased stop initiated by rule: slo.p95.delta > 2x baseline AND error_rate > 0.5%. Current status: CANARY PAUSED at 10% traffic. Reason: p95 spike + 5xx.

maya: ok hold. do NOT increase traffic. we should decide pin vs rollback. rolling back would be noisy for shared pool. pinning old model variant v2.3.1 on the embeddings route and routing new release to a small shadow route might be safer. thoughts?

kai: agree with pin first. quick check: does v2.3.1 have the same kernel selection? if the spike is kv shard warmup we can also try warming TTLs then unpause. but pin + warm sounds low-risk.

sophie: I can push a warm request set to embed-worker-3 and increase cache prefill for shard=12. will run a small job: `scripts/prefill_kv --route embeddings --shard 12 --rate 50/s for 60s`

ron: i'll update the release notes and the changelog channel with the hold + pin decision. also creating a follow-up ticket for deeper postmortem: INF-4123.

maya: kai, if pinning is fast, do it. steps: 1) pin embeddings route to model:v2.3.1 in routing service 2) confirm request rates on the pinned route 3) run prefill 4) monitor p95 and 5xx for 5m before any ramp.

kai: starting step 1 now. patching route config: `PATCH /routing/embeddings {"version":"v2.3.1","reason":"canary-pause pin due to p95 spike"}`

deploy-bot: routing update applied by kai at 17:05:02Z — embeddings -> v2.3.1 (pinned).

sophie: running prefill now (job id pf-1745). logs: first 30s look clean, success callbacks 98%.

maya: monitoring windows open: p95, 5xx, kv_miss_rate, worker_cpu. keep messages short, report any regression.

ron: release-notes channel updated: "v2026.03.22-rc3 paused for embeddings p95 spike; pin to v2.3.1 applied for stability; postmortem ticket INF-4123." cc @support @customer-success

kai: p95 back down to 130ms after prefill, 5xx at 0.15%. kv_miss_rate trending down. good so far.

ops-bot: Canary PAUSE remains. Manual approval required to resume. Reason: operator hold.

maya: ok keeping paused. we'll reconvene in 30m for decision to continue rollout or rollback. if any new 5xx > 0.5% flag immediate rollback plan (rollback -> v2.3.1 globally).

sophie: capturing trace snippets for the incident and attaching to INF-4123.

kai: leaving a note in routing: "pinned during canary due to kv warmup; revisit kernel selection & shard placement for embeddings."

maya: thanks all. good triage.

ron: created postmortem stub INF-4123-01 and assigned to eng-ml + eng-runtime. will expand once we have logs.

deploy-bot: deployment records updated: canary paused at 10% (1745554322). audit id a-1745554322.

maya: closing the thread for now; continue monitoring in INF-4123 thread. :eyes:
